message:
Let me take a step back and think about this more carefully. The MSAN uninitialized read in `cmp` reading `first`/`last` means those bytes are uninitialized. The only way this happens is if the blob contains uninitialized bytes.

Let me check how the morx table blob is created. The `_hb_face_for_data_reference_table` creates a sub-blob. But maybe there's a different path. Let me check `hb_ot_face_data`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "morx" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-face.hh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-ot-face.cc 2>/dev/null; echo "==="; grep -rn "morx" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/src/hb-aat-layout.cc</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
